_comment: Sample CVE database for educational vulnerability tracking.
_note: Real CVE data is fetched from nvd.nist.gov or cve.mitre.org.

vulnerabilities.name: Log4Shell
vulnerabilities.description: Remote code execution via crafted log messages. One of the worst vulnerabilities ever found.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update to Log4j 2.15.0 or later immediately. Disable JNDI if update not possible.

vulnerabilities.name: Dirty Pipe
vulnerabilities.description: Local privilege escalation — allows unprivileged user to overwrite read-only files.

vulnerabilities.name: PrintNightmare
vulnerabilities.description: Remote code execution via Windows Print Spooler. Widely exploited in the wild.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply Microsoft's July 2021 cumulative update. Disable Print Spooler if not needed.

vulnerabilities.name: Outlook NTLM Hash Leak
vulnerabilities.description: Zero-click vulnerability — attacker sends specially crafted email to steal NTLM hashes.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply Microsoft March 2023 Patch Tuesday updates.

vulnerabilities.name: Follina / MSDT
vulnerabilities.description: Remote code execution via malicious Office documents — no macros needed.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply June 2022 Patch Tuesday. Disable MSDT protocol as interim workaround.

vulnerabilities.name: BlueKeep
vulnerabilities.description: Wormable RCE in RDP — exploitable without authentication. Similar to WannaCry risk level.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Apply May 2019 patches. Disable RDP if not needed. Use NLA.
